sentences.en: A mirror is better than an entire row of ancestral portraits.
sentences.zh: 一面镜子胜过一整排祖先肖像。

sentences.en: It's impossible to return Native Americans all of their ancestral lands.
sentences.zh: 不可能将所有祖传土地归还给美洲原住民。

sentences.en: This is the ancestral territory of the Navajo people.
sentences.zh: 这是纳瓦霍人的祖传领土。

senses.zh: 祖先的,与祖先有关的,祖宗传下的
